data.name: Sreenu
data.gender_notes: Sreenu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sreenu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sri', which means 'God's Grace' or 'Fortune'. The name is also associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. The name Sreenu carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Telugu, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sreenu usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sreenu represents the divine grace of God and the blessings of the Goddess Lakshmi. It is a name that signifies prosperity, wealth, and good fortune in one's life.
data.etymology: Sreenu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sreenu total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
